attribution.note: Marcus states the capability claim in his own voice; it is separate from his quotations of Dennett.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the present capability, broad identity coverage, on-demand availability, negligible cost and sufficient-data condition. Capability language here is not a probabilistic hedge.

contract.note: Convincing short likeness videos with broad identity coverage and negligible production cost are a fair ordinary reading in context. The contract reasonably avoids requiring flawless impersonation, although realism and cost thresholds remain interpretive.

evidence.note: The contemporaneous report describes realistic synthetic media and inexpensive tools, but does not establish representative identity coverage, convincing video likenesses and total production costs together.

Published before the evaluation cutoff, this developer disclosure retrospectively dates availability to early February. It supplies neither representative identity tests nor February production costs; its performance claims are not independent findings.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes relevant tools and general progress, but does not settle the combined identity, realism, availability and negligible-cost claim during February 1–14. It also establishes no substantial barrier sufficient to contradict it. Missing measurements warrant an unresolved finding.
